description: Find tours similar to one TripWays tour that have open start times on a date, or a date range of up to 31 days, for a group. Pass the tour the traveler wanted (bokun_id), the date, and party_size or travelers. Returns up to limit similar tours (1 to 5, default 3), each with its card and up to three open start times with seats left, plus the original tour's own status for those dates. It reads several live calendars, so it can take a few seconds.

date_end.description: Inclusive end; default = date. Max 31 days.

party_size.description: Occupied seats to keep. Wins over travelers when both are set.

travelers.description: Simple ages; mapped to occupied seats. Used only when party_size is omitted.

name: find_alternatives

slots.description: Up to three open start times. Pass start_time_id to get_price_quote / get_booking_link.

bokun_id.description: Tour id; the number in tripways.com/t/{id}.

bookable_natively.description: True when checkout_url opens TripWays checkout; false when it opens the operator calendar.

from_price.description: What one adult pays: the tour page's From price, the same price Google shows.

gttd_eligible.description: Listed on Google Things to Do.

low_confidence.description: True when there are fewer than 10 reviews.

reason.description: Why checkout works the way it does, e.g. pickup_required.

checked.description: How many similar tours' calendars were read.

error.description: Present when ok is false. code: tour_not_found, destination_not_found, destination_ambiguous, or unpriced. message is written for the traveler.

source.description: The tour that was asked about and its own status for these dates.

status.description: ok, no_schedule, no_fit, calendar_gone, or unknown.

title: Find alternatives
